title: Creator Evolution Walkthrough
subtitle: Turn a rough idea into polished options

scenes.caption: Open Creator Evolution and frame the tool.
scenes.narration: Creator Evolution is the advanced creation engine. Start with the messy idea, choose the format and voice, then let the system turn it into options that sound like the account.

scenes.caption: Show the raw idea, format, voice, and output area.
scenes.narration: The workflow is simple. Raw angle in, format selected, voice selected, and then the strongest generated option becomes the post candidate.
